# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 with compiler XML documentation and synchronized HarfBuzz bindings. The release also corrects a HarfBuzz enum name and removes aggregate flag members that do not represent independent options.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — The corrected upstream name is CCC132 and retains numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133 to use CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed** — Aggregate Defined enum values do not represent independent options. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags required by the application.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Brings the 4.154 preview line to the Chrome m154 renderer and its upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation is now compiler-generated** — NuGet packages now ship compiler XML documentation sourced from the C# API comments, including Markdown-capable view remarks. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from Skia's DEPS-pinned native source, keeping supported bindings synchronized with HarfBuzz 14.2.1 while retaining a focused managed API.
